provenance: Owned by W1-23 round 2. RI-LOR01 comparison method §4 counts named factions in this directory; before this file it did not exist and the axis was unmeasurable. RI-LOR08 / CF-C023's own condition, restated in the round-1 verdict: "if tribes are wanted, they need a faction each, not a mention each." This is the faction each. The tribes' NPC records already carried these six ids as their `faction` field before this file existed (see `game/data/npcs/**`); what was missing was a record answering what the id NAMES — the same gap `game/data/progression/factions.json` closes for `house-dres` and `shadowscale-order`, which this file deliberately does not touch or duplicate.
note_on_names: The six names — Agacephs, Paatru, Archein, Sarpa, Dead-Water, Miredancers — are established Argonian-tribe names (CF-C023 `sources_real`, UESP Lore:Argonian tribes), used deliberately rather than invented, the way this project also keeps `House Dres`. What is this project's own invention is the STRUCTURE below: the rank ladder, the relation to the province's four constructed bodies, and every stance in `corpus/60-lore/data/canon-facts.json` CF-D022 through CF-D027 that these ranks gate the speaking of. A reader auditing RI-LOR01 §6 ("can the critic say within 30 seconds whether a claim is canon or ours") should read this line first: the noun is canon, the politics are not.

factions.name: Agacephs
factions.premise: Answer to nobody in the province and keep it that way on purpose — no well, no lease, no dealings with the Empire and none sought. Bury their own dead however far it costs, and hold that the fault for a body lost far from home is the province's, not the family's (CF-D022/C).

relations.rootkeepers: no standing relationship — the Agacephs do not recognise a rootkeeper's writ over their own ground
relations.the-provincial-office: no dealings, no hostility — CF-C023's `empire` axis for this people, and the reason no Agaceph appears on any Provincial roll

factions.name: Paatru
factions.premise: Live below the surface, in dug pits reached by rope, and count the Duskfall as three separate burnings where the province's other histories count one (CF-D025/C) — the clay itself is their evidence, and they will make a visitor dig for it.

relations.the-wet-ledger: never met one of them, by the Paatru's own account — the axis CF-C023 records as `never-met-one`
relations.rootkeepers: no recorded contact; the pits are not on any rootkeeper's circuit

factions.name: Sarpa
factions.premise: Read the province's stepped ruins as roosts, not roads or aqueducts (CF-D027/A), and hold the Duskfall happened in a single night because every ruin fell the same way at once — a claim only visible from the air, which is where a Sarpa flier has actually looked.

relations.the-provincial-office: weighs the coin and drops it — trades when useful, holds no loyalty, the axis CF-C023 records as `weigh-the-coin-and-drop-it`
relations.rootkeepers: no standing relationship; the stone forest is outside the rootkeepers' circuit

factions.name: Archein
factions.premise: The only one of the six with a formal place in Imperial administration — CF-C023's `empire` axis records them as its rural governance outright. Hold estate-Hists behind Gideon's walls as real Hists, entered and tithed as such, and treat sap decanted into a cup at the estate as no different from sap at the root (CF-D023/A, CF-D024/A). The `archein-holder` and `archein-factor` actors speaking those positions ARE this faction's own two ranks.

relations.the-provincial-office: administers rural governance on the Office's behalf — the closest any Argonian people comes to standing inside Imperial structure rather than beside it
relations.rootkeepers: the rootkeepers who inspect and sign the Gideon wall-tree's status are named directly in CF-D023's held_by list, and dispute it

factions.name: Miredancers
factions.premise: Organised around a named, descending speaking-office rather than a bloodline (CF-C023's `hist` axis) — a Speaker inherits the name and the standing to argue, not a family holding. Hold that Hists reach one another by whatever root is nearest and awake regardless of whose it originally was (CF-D022/B), which is the direct rebuttal to the Archein estate model.

relations.the-provincial-office: cordial and unhelpful in the same breath — trades words freely and nothing else
relations.rootkeepers: the sap-speaker and miredancer-elder actors argue three separate rootkeeper-adjacent disputes (CF-D023, CF-D024, CF-D026) directly against Archein and Dead-Water positions

factions.name: Dead-Water
factions.premise: War-bands who wear the bone of their own dead into battle and hold it keeps the dead fighting rather than merely honours them (CF-D026/A) — the one people in the province whose dead are, by their own account, still combatants. Keep no burial ground of their own and carry their fallen to the nearest one instead (CF-C023's `hist` axis).

relations.the-provincial-office: closes the tracks — the axis CF-C023 records as `close-the-tracks`, the most adversarial of the six toward Imperial movement
relations.the-shadowscale-order: no formal standing; the two are never named against each other in any registered dispute
